Recorded result  PASSED — The first MusicGen load failed because the shared class selected MusicgenDecoderConfig. A local subclass bound MusicgenConfig without changing the installed package or publisher files. The corrected actual CUDA request generated 256 audio-code tokens and a 5.06-second mono WAV. The initial failure and corrected complete capture are both printed.
Scope  File duration and waveform measurements do not grade musical quality.

exercises.title: Inspect waveform and spectral activity
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The actual generated MusicGen waveform and STFT were retained and checked for frame/rate consistency. Spectral magnitude is not calibrated loudness or a music-quality score. Listening remains a separate assessment.
Scope  File duration and waveform measurements do not grade musical quality.

exercises.title: Measure the cost of a longer audio sequence
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The 512-token MusicGen request produced 325,760 frames at 32 kHz, or 10.18 seconds, versus 161,920 frames and 5.06 seconds for 256 tokens.
Scope  The recorded inference real-time factor excludes load/export and does not measure first-audio latency; these complete-waveform calls are not streaming.

exercises.title: Compare prompts seeds and music quality
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  BLOCKED — The Windows-elevated tracing comparison leaves device timing blocked. No new music generation or listening review occurred during that comparison. The owner’s overall response “good” remains a REPORTED assessment of the earlier clips; detailed ratings remain unassessed.
Scope  The matched audio files and the missing device timeline have separate outcomes.

exercises.title: Synthesize a short diagnostic statement
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual CUDA MMS English synthesis generated 62,464 frames at 16 kHz, or 3.904 seconds. Raw float waveform and PCM WAV are retained. The program performed no playback or microphone capture.
Scope  The saved waveform and the recorded listening observations answer different questions.

exercises.title: Visualize speech before diagnosing the model
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh waveform/STFT figure now uses the actual CUDA synthesis output. Independent decoding confirms a maximum float-to-PCM difference of approximately 3.70e-5.
Scope  Encoding quantization is a separate boundary from model output and from perceived speech quality.

exercises.title: Test text normalization pronunciation and reproducibility
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual symbol/expanded-text and same/changed-seed TTS requests completed. Identical seed and text produced equal waveform arrays in this environment; a changed seed changed output length. The retained capture preserves the full tokenization.
Scope  Tokenizer inspection does not establish pronunciation, and no human listening rating was supplied.

exercises.title: Bound long speech and diagnose service latency
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  BLOCKED — The Windows-elevated WSL2 retry still fails the shared device-timestamp prerequisite. Earlier TTS output and host/waveform observations remain historical; no new synthesis or first-audio measurement was made.
Scope  Synthesis completion alone cannot attribute a delay to an individual kernel.

exercises.title: Transcribe the retained speech control
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual CUDA Whisper tiny transcribed the retained MMS utterance. Preserve raw leading whitespace and the explicitly normalized word-error calculation. This is a synthetic TTS-to-ASR round trip, not an independent human-labelled speech benchmark.
Scope  Keep the reference wording, acoustic input and normalization policy with each recognition score.

exercises.title: Score recognition without hiding normalization choices
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Fresh scoring controls retained WER above one and an undefined empty-reference denominator. Actual same-decoder tests used lower amplitude, fixed noise, clipping and an incorrect rate header. Complete hypotheses remain. The intended TTS text is the reference; its pronunciation has not been independently human-verified.
Scope  Keep the reference wording, acoustic input and normalization policy with each recognition score.

exercises.title: Recognize the absence of acoustic evidence
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual CUDA Whisper returned “you” for digital silence and for quiet noise. Those word outputs fail the absence-of-evidence criterion even though the test commands completed. The spoken-word control remains. Recognized text from this experiment was never treated as authorization to run tools.
Scope  Keep the reference wording, acoustic input and normalization policy with each recognition score.

exercises.title: Chunk longer recordings without losing offsets
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The complete 48 kHz joined recording was resampled to 395,488 frames at 16 kHz and covered by contiguous 320,000- and 75,488-frame chunks. Combined normalized WER is 8/56, or 0.142857. Fresh model loads are included in per-chunk command time; this is not a streaming latency test. Boundary clips await human listening.
Scope  Keep the reference wording, acoustic input and normalization policy with each recognition score.

exercises.title: Adapt a small speech recognizer and inspect frozen weights
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The duplicate train/dev audio attempt was rejected. With distinct synthetic sentences, four CUDA updates trained only the final Whisper decoder block; the retained check reports unchanged frozen weights. Training loss decreased, but development WER stayed 0.4 with the same hypothesis. This qualifies training plumbing, not generalization or complete resume behavior.
Scope  The bounded adaptation is assessed on its specified split and outputs.

exercises.title: Run a bounded image adapter experiment
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual SDXL LoRA training completed two CUDA updates with finite step losses of about 0.00338 and 0.00459. The first full-precision loader exhausted guest headroom; later failures exposed Python 3.14 dataset compatibility, offline adapter discovery and offload/inference-mode interaction. The retained corrections load frozen weights in FP16, select the local adapter filename explicitly and use no_grad for the matched comparison. Both square outputs show nested frames rather than the intended filled square.
Scope  Changed pixels establish an adapter effect, not improved image quality; two teaching images cannot establish generalization.

exercises.title: Connect speech recognition to a local language model and speech synthesis
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The serial pipeline ran actual CUDA ASR and TTS around a local text-model request, reusing the recorded workload speech input. Child commands, timings, separate stdout/stderr, recognized text, exact HTTP request/response and final waveform are retained. Silence, endpoint and length guards remain separate CPU controls. The wrapper never executes recognized or generated commands.
Scope  A completed pipeline does not establish listening quality or factual correctness of the spoken answer.

exercises.title: Share GPU ownership and deploy bounded media requests
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The non-root Docker MMS service kept one warmed CUDA model owner, with a 256-character/4096-byte limit and no queued uploads. The retained requests returned 200 for accepted synthesis, 422 for overlength input, 408 for an expired deadline and 429 for two concurrent requests while busy. Both successful WAVs are finite and nonzero. The first shutdown required SIGKILL (exit 137); signal handling plus --init reduced the corrected stop to about 2.58 seconds with exit 0.
Scope  These checks do not establish mid-kernel cancellation or a Kubernetes media rollout.

exercises.title: Inspect an NGC resource before downloading it
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh public NGC metadata receipt identifies the pinned CLI resource, its publisher, architecture, byte count and checksum. Acquisition identity and permission to redistribute remain separate questions. The recorded run used the existing catalogue pin; it did not relabel it as the latest release.
Scope  Catalog and image metadata precede execution of the selected asset.

exercises.title: Acquire and inspect the native ARM64 CLI
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The verified ARM64 CLI archive was extracted and executed under WSL2. Both the native version command and public resource query returned exit 0, closing the earlier loader-execution gap for this CLI. The archive checksum and native-loader outcome remain distinct evidence; authenticated assets were not tested.
Scope  Catalog and image metadata precede execution of the selected asset.

exercises.title: Resolve a container to a native immutable identity
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The immutable ARM64 NGC PyTorch image was pulled and ran the numerical CUDA probe successfully. Its PyTorch 2.14.0a0+b2c75dd062.nv26.09 reports framework CUDA 13.4, device capability 12.1 and zero error for the small oracle. Those container identities differ from host PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130.
Scope  Successful execution of this image does not certify every NGC container or model.

exercises.title: Diagnose catalog failures before GPU work
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Fresh CPU manifest controls rejected a missing ARM64 entry, a duplicate ARM64 selection and a changed digest before launching GPU work.
Scope  These intentional mutations exercise the acquisition boundary; they are not observed publisher incidents or GPU failures.

exercises.title: Inspect pinned model and dataset identities
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The recorded run rechecked pinned Hugging Face model and dataset identities through public metadata and retained the receipts.
Scope  A repository revision, card and file inventory identify candidate inputs; they do not establish trained quality or permission for every downstream use.

exercises.title: Acquire a selective model snapshot
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Selective acquisition retained the pinned small model snapshot and verified its selected files. The complete receipt records the revision and hashes. This acquisition is separate from the offline CPU/CUDA execution that follows.
Scope  The snapshot and dataset checks apply to the recorded immutable revisions.

exercises.title: Load the snapshot offline and check its outputs
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The pinned random BERT ran offline on CPU and CUDA with pooled shape 2×32. Both within-device repeats were exact, the instrumented Python socket-connect count stayed zero, and independent array comparison gives maximum CPU/CUDA error 1.1920928955078125e-7 against the declared 1e-4 tolerance. The random model is a loading and numerical control; it has no demonstrated sentence-embedding quality.
Scope  The snapshot and dataset checks apply to the recorded immutable revisions.

exercises.title: Audit a pinned dataset before fine tuning
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The retained audit reports five training and five test rows, no exact identifier or normalized-text overlap, and rejection of an injected overlap. Training readiness remains NOT ESTABLISHED because card provenance and licensing are incomplete.
Scope  The snapshot and dataset checks apply to the recorded immutable revisions.

exercises.title: Acquire and identify the monitoring tools
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Pinned native ARM64 Prometheus and Grafana downloads passed the retained checksum/version checks. These are tool identities. Exporter semantics, a working query backend, displayed series and workload correlation are qualified separately in the following exercises.
Scope  Identifying the monitoring binaries precedes scraping a live target.

exercises.title: Prove that unavailable does not mean idle
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Fresh intentional field simulations distinguish a real zero from unavailable, stale and malformed measurements, and check unit conversion and histogram contracts. CPU execution of these controls is current laptop evidence; the injected GPU counters remain synthetic.
Scope  A missing field, a present zero and an unreachable target require three different interpretations.

exercises.title: Start and inspect the native WSL2 stack
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Prometheus scraped the fixture, and the native WSL2 stack returned series through Grafana’s data-source backend. Record 214.01 ends with “No WSL2/GPU/Docker execution claimed”. The current integration.py prints “GPU measurements in this integration use the simulated fixture.” Both messages refer to the fixture values.
Scope  A missing field, a present zero and an unreachable target require three different interpretations.

exercises.title: Provision and qualify the Grafana dashboard
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The recorded experiment rendered baseline, missing-field and real-zero dashboard states after retaining browser-library and startup-race failures. Raw exposition omits the busy gauge when unavailable but retains a 0.0 sample with availability 1 for a real zero. Supplied screenshots and backend responses are retained together.
Scope  Live WSL charts are a separate observation from these fixture charts; a displayed line alone cannot establish collection scope or freshness.

exercises.title: Read rates, histograms and latency correctly
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Each synthetic 20-request trial records 18 successes and two errors, at configured delays of 20 ms and 100 ms. Raw buckets are cumulative counts.
Scope  The displayed Prometheus p95 is an interpolation over the query’s one-minute window, which can mix nearby trials; it is not the exact percentile of a particular 20-response sample.

exercises.title: Test alert transitions and missing evidence
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Six promtool scenarios passed, and the native integration retained actual alert pending, firing and resolution transitions under intentional counter faults. Missing evidence remains an availability condition, not zero utilization.
Scope  Rule evaluation and the physical GPU state are separate sources.

exercises.title: Observe a live workload and attach inference servers
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Three unmonitored and three monitored Triton TensorRT trials each returned 32/32 successful numerical responses and three expected HTTP 400 rejections. Recorded p95 values were 3.39–4.90 ms without monitoring and 4.86–5.67 ms with monitoring. Six short sequential trials do not establish a stable overhead percentage. Live WSL fields include memory, utilization, temperature and power draw; power limit and memory clock remain unavailable. The collector interval is five seconds, much longer than individual requests.
Scope  The five-second device samples cover a window much longer than these individual requests.

exercises.title: Move monitoring into containers and connect Kubernetes
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Digest-pinned native monitoring containers started, and Grafana’s backend returned data. A separate native monitor attached to loopback-forwarded K3s Triton metrics; 32 requests passed the numerical oracle. Prometheus up changed from 1 to 0 when forwarding ended. That down state diagnoses reachability through the forwarding path, not necessarily a crashed GPU workload. The namespace and owned processes were cleaned up; deployment remains a bounded laboratory result.
Scope  The container and cluster observations depend on their own networking and device discovery.

exercises.title: Isolate and identify the orchestration environment
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The orchestration packages were installed in a separate environment, with pip check and exact versions retained. All 86 distributions in the original CUDA exercise environment remained unchanged. Interpreter, framework and model-server identities must be read from the environment actually used by each command.
Scope  Grade tool selection and final evidence claims independently of transport success.

exercises.title: Observe the tool loop and inject faults
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Fresh LangChain SDK controls exercised a scripted tool loop and injected faults. The framework and loopback operations ran on the laptop, while model responses and evidence fixtures were intentionally simulated.
Scope  This result does not establish learned planning quality.

exercises.title: Qualify the HTTP boundary and local model
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — A real CUDA-served Qwen model used the framework’s read-only tools against simulated evidence. The retained conversation contains 12 tool calls, only two unique calls, and therefore ten duplicates; the intermediate answer hit a length limit before a later stop. The tool payload’s 28/30 GiB figure is fictional teaching data, not a new measurement of this laptop.
Scope  Protocol acceptance does not erase repetition or establish the final diagnostic recommendation.

exercises.title: Resume after the Python process exits
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh LangGraph control retained a SQLite checkpoint, exited its Python process and resumed in another process. The scripted evidence and model remain intentional controls.
Scope  Successful local restart does not establish multi-host recovery or exactly-once side effects.

exercises.title: Reject wrong-thread and duplicate continuation
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh continuation controls rejected the wrong thread and handled duplicate continuation according to the retained state contract. Inspect the committed checkpoint and event identity, rather than treating a second successful API call as a second legitimate action.
Scope  The persisted thread identity and approval determine which action can resume.

exercises.title: Put a bounded model call behind review
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The learned-model graph paused for review and resumed in a separate invocation, with the local CUDA endpoint and checkpoint retained. Its resumed agent made one tool call and stopped normally. The tool still supplies simulated 28/30 GiB memory evidence; the run qualifies graph/model integration, not an actual diagnosis of this machine.
Scope  The persisted thread identity and approval determine which action can resume.

exercises.title: Preserve nested traces, errors and redaction
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The new local LangSmith SDK control retained nested trace relationships, an error and explicit redaction behavior without sending a hosted request.
Scope  A locally serialized trace is observable evidence, but it does not establish hosted ingestion, indexing or dashboard visibility.

exercises.title: Run an offline evaluation and preserve its failures
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The offline evaluation ran again and preserved its failing cases. The teaching dataset and scripted outputs remain synthetic.
Scope  Keep each case’s expected result, observed result and evaluator identity; an aggregate score does not explain a diagnostic failure.

exercises.title: Plan and qualify an optional LangSmith service
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  BLOCKED — The fixed synthetic LangSmith request plan was executed again but not sent.
Scope  LANGSMITH_API_KEY is absent; hosted ingestion, readback and UI qualification remain BLOCKED.

exercises.title: Reject a plausible but invalid finding
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Fresh PydanticAI controls rejected plausible but invalid structured findings and exercised retry behavior through real SDK code.
Scope  Schema validity, evidence support and diagnostic correctness are separate checks; the scripted model is not a learned-model evaluation.

exercises.title: Bound persistent invalid output
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh control bounded persistent invalid output and retained the exhausted retry/budget outcome.
Scope  A retry limit is an operational boundary; it does not make the final invalid answer acceptable.

exercises.title: Use the typed agent with a local endpoint
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The typed agent completed against the actual local CUDA model endpoint. A separate attempt after the server stopped failed with exit 1, and its full transport error remains in the companion.
Scope  Typed-output acceptance does not prove factual or diagnostic correctness, and a stopped endpoint must not silently fall back to a fixture.

exercises.title: Verify Choice, Score and Noul contracts
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The fresh local Jev controls exercised Choice, Score and Noul response contracts with explicit simulated payloads. The code and adapter ran; no hosted Jev model was called. Versioned fields, abstention and normalization remain part of the contract.
Scope  The local contract and calibration records have different evidentiary scope from a hosted model response.

exercises.title: Measure calibration and risk versus coverage
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The six-row calibration control is intentionally synthetic. Independent arithmetic reproduces Brier score 0.2916666666666667 and the recorded risk/coverage points.
Scope  Confidence thresholding can reduce coverage without reducing risk on this tiny example; this is not measured calibration of Jev, Qwen or any deployed model.

exercises.title: Prepare a versioned Jev request and optional service run
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  BLOCKED — The fixed synthetic Jev request plan was executed again but not sent.
Scope  TYPESAFE_API_KEY is absent; hosted model behavior and service UI qualification remain BLOCKED.

exercises.title: Qualify a native Ollama installation
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The native ARM64 Ollama client/daemon and selected runtime were identified, with local-only service settings and inventories retained. An empty model list is different from a failed daemon. GPU model loading and request outcomes follow separately.
Scope  Loaded model identity, request completion and output quality require separate observations.

exercises.title: Import a model and diagnose stream completion
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Ollama imported the pinned Qwen 1.5B GGUF and retained its model digest, template, capabilities, raw streamed response and terminal status. The actual GPU model request is the main illustration. A length-limited terminal event is distinct from a normally completed answer even when transport succeeds.
Scope  Loaded model identity, request completion and output quality require separate observations.

exercises.title: Obtain sentence embeddings through Ollama
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The actual EmbeddingGemma request returned three finite, nonzero sentence vectors of a consistent dimension. Publisher identity, model license and raw response are retained.
Scope  Shape and finite-value checks qualify the API result; they do not measure retrieval ranking, semantic separation or transfer quality.

exercises.title: Compare residency and bounded worker service
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Cold and warm requests, three bounded client workers, residency and unload outcomes are retained for one Ollama model owner. OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 means the client worker count does not demonstrate concurrent kernel execution.
Scope  Residency and a processor-placement percentage are not GPU utilization or proof of overlap.

exercises.title: Freeze the base and audit a tiny training split
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The existing pinned Qwen 1.5B base was reused, with its complete file-hash receipt and the 12-training/4-heldout synthetic split retained. Unsloth dependencies use an isolated overlay that reuses the qualified native Torch/NumPy/CUDA libraries; the original environment stayed unchanged. Failed dependency resolution remains evidence rather than a reason to overwrite the working CUDA stack.
Scope  A successful training update or valid output syntax does not by itself establish task improvement.

exercises.title: Run a bounded QLoRA smoke training session
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Actual Unsloth QLoRA completed five CUDA optimizer updates with 9,232,384 trainable parameters, sequence length 256, microbatch 1 and accumulation 4. The recorded evaluation loss fell from 5.8703 to 3.5985; peak PyTorch allocation was about 1.35 GiB and reservation 1.68 GiB. Those allocator counters exclude other process/driver use. The four heldout synthetic examples are too few for a generalization claim.
Scope  A successful training update or valid output syntax does not by itself establish task improvement.

exercises.title: Resume with the original optimizer and base identity
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Training resumed the saved step-5 checkpoint through global step 10 with the same bound base and training contract; recorded evaluation loss reached 2.6536. Optimizer, scheduler and RNG payload identities were retained locally, but their bytes are excluded from this export. This demonstrates the recorded continuation, not bitwise equivalence to an uninterrupted ten-step run.
Scope  A successful training update or valid output syntax does not by itself establish task improvement.

exercises.title: Evaluate and prepare an adapter for serving
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Forty fresh requests distinguish label format from accuracy. Grammar constrains all 32 affected responses to complete valid labels; F16 answers 7/16 correctly and Q4_K_M 5/16. Original prompts/token IDs and model identities are retained. The output-contract investigation PASSED; the experimental model remains NOT PROMOTED.
Scope  A successful training update or valid output syntax does not by itself establish task improvement.

exercises.title: Qualify llmster and distinguish inventory from residency
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED after recovery — The first headless LM Studio bootstrap ran out of temporary space. The recovery moved 3,527 files with matching hashes, verified the cached archive with SHA-512 and used temporary space on the project disk. The native llmster, runtime and model-inventory checks then passed.
Scope  The selected runtime, observed model residency and individual response record are separate checks.

exercises.title: Import a verified model and exercise the local API
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The local LM Studio API completed actual model requests after correcting the inventory modelKey and using fresh output directories. Separate CPU/full-GPU controls retained native layer arguments, CUDA-library mappings and device memory observations: 2,690 MiB before loading, 2,923 MiB CPU-loaded and 3,924 MiB GPU-loaded. The 1,001 MiB increase from the CPU-loaded to the GPU-loaded sample supports changed residency; it is not a kernel trace or an isolated allocation measurement.
Scope  Ordinary requests used partial offload; a requested layer fraction is not a memory quota.

exercises.title: Diagnose incomplete streams and loading delays
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Warm and post-reload requests used fresh directories and retained terminal response status. The load/reload command duration and the later response latency measure different intervals.
Scope  A quicker warm request does not by itself identify which cache, model page or initialization stage was reused.

exercises.title: Serve embeddings and connect local agents
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — LM Studio rejected the Ollama EmbeddingGemma blob because its loader expected 316 tensors but found 314. That failed attempt remains. The existing Nomic embedding GGUF was independently matched to publisher hash/license metadata and then returned valid vectors. Direct LangChain tool and PydanticAI typed-agent calls also completed.
Scope  API compatibility and vector shape do not establish embedding quality or diagnostic validity.

exercises.title: Record the upstream and conversion identities
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The recorded run retained immutable NVIDIA upstream and ggml-org conversion identities, selected Q4/Q8/BF16 sizes and LFS hashes. The Q8 GGUF receipt is 33,585,500,064 bytes, about 31.28 GiB, larger than the 31,232 MiB (30.5 GiB) NVML total. This is a concrete larger-than-reported-device-budget candidate; its actual tensor placement and working buffers must still be measured.
Scope  A weight-file estimate is a planning input. The guarded run records the actual placement.

exercises.title: Admit a model that exceeds the reported GPU budget
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — Windows CIM reports a 64 GiB physical memory module while the OS-visible value is about 32.23 GiB; WSL exposes about 15.70 GiB and CUDA reports about 45.97 GiB. These are overlapping views, not independent pools to add. The recorded run preserves an initially overconservative admission rejection and its scoped correction. Fresh Q8 headroom reduced the initial 45-layer plan to 43 layers. Admission authorizes a guarded trial; it does not prove fit or a maximum allocation ceiling. No WSL or pagefile settings changed.
Scope  A weight-file estimate is a planning input. The guarded run records the actual placement.

exercises.title: Qualify hybrid kernels and partial offload
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — The guarded Nemotron Q8 trial actually loaded 43 of 53 offloadable units on CUDA (52 model layers plus the output layer in this runtime count) with 26,181.93 MiB of GPU model buffers and 5,840.22 MiB of host model buffers. KV buffers split into 10 MiB GPU and 2 MiB CPU; recurrent-state buffers split into 37.27 MiB GPU and 10.35 MiB CPU. Matched Q4 trials at context 2,048 and 4,096 doubled attention KV from 12 to 24 MiB while recurrent state stayed at 47.62 MiB. Requested layer count, actual tensor placement and hybrid state are separate observations. Raw response truncation and the initial port-bind failure remain visible.
Scope  A weight-file estimate is a planning input. The guarded run records the actual placement.

exercises.title: Compare deployment and decide whether to fine tune
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — With the same Q4 model, explicit reasoning-off prompt rendering, context 2048 and a 512-token output cap, all eight native/Ollama requests complete with HTTP 200. All four number-only arithmetic responses are exactly “4”. Completion/format qualification PASSED after an initial headroom refusal, but diagnostic factual quality remains insufficient for promotion.
Scope  Compare the complete outputs on matched inputs before deciding whether training is justified.

exercises.title: Compare WSL2 and CUDA memory boundaries
exercises.evidence_note:
Recorded result  PASSED — eighteen ordinary 1 GiB uint8 CUDA tensors were simultaneously retained, written and checked across every byte. The 19,327,352,832 verified bytes exceed measured guest MemTotal of 16,854,429,696 bytes by 2,472,923,136 bytes. The preceding 1 GiB pilot, final process and wrapper exits, and release observations also passed.
Scope  A verified 18 GiB allocation does not identify a maximum, residency tier or page-migration history.
